procedure: Freeze one selected architecture, sampler, fixed20000update endpoint and comparison. Train fresh seed1 and seed2 on the same33optimization donors. Use two fixed generation replicates and matched resampling traces for each training seed.
selection: Seed0 supports calibration iteration. Seed1/2 confirm the same configuration; never replace incumbent or call a random favorable seed an improvement.

stable_joint_target.mean_ES: Mean of the three training-seed calibration donor energy scores at least5percent below the mean of their matched resampling scores.
stable_joint_target.per_seed: Each of all three seeds has lower calibration energy score and no greater cell energy distance than its matched resampling baseline.
stable_joint_target.spread: All three total donor spread ratios lie in[0.7,1.3].
stable_joint_target.validity: All fixed endpoints, count contracts, source/checkpoint bindings and owned cleanup verified.

statistical_scope: Same four adaptive calibration donors, one per stage. Training seeds and generated cells are not independent real donors. No independent biological confirmation or external SOTA claim.
evaluation: Keep evaluation-donor scores outside model and seed ranking. Any later frozen-model evaluation is reported separately.
